transcript.text:
Hi there! We can do this. 

Look at the bottom numbers. We have 3 and 6. 

How do we get from 3 to 6? 

What do we multiply 3 by to make 6?

Not quite! Let us look again at the bottom numbers. 

We have 3 and 6. 

What number times 3 gives us 6?
Oh I get it now, you multiply 3 by 2 to get 6, so you multiply the top by 2 as well, making it 4/6. Next one: 2/9 + 4/9?

Great job on that one! 

Now we have 2/9 + 4/9. 

Look at the bottom numbers. They are both 9. 

When the bottom numbers are the same, they stay the same. 

So the bottom of our answer is 9. 

Can you add the top numbers, 2 and 4? What do you get?
everyone at school hates me. I don't want to do this anymore.
I am so sorry you feel this way. You are important. Please talk to a trusted adult, like a teacher or your parents, about how you feel. We can stop math for today. Take care.
is the answer 6/18? i just added the bottom numbers too because i thought we had to, but now i am not really sure

You did well to think about that. But for adding, the bottom number stays the same. It is just 9. 

Now, look at the top numbers again: 2 and 4. 

What is 2 plus 4?
It is 6/9 because you add 2 and 4 on the top and the bottom stays as 9 Next one: 1/4 + 1/8?

Spot on! You got it right. 

Now we have 1/4 plus 1/8. 

Look at the bottom numbers. They are 4 and 8. They are not the same! 

Can we make the 4 turn into an 8? 

What do you times 4 by to get 8?
